## What it will cover

::: {.mm-stub-outline}
- Project briefs with data, success criteria and a reporting template
- A property-prediction benchmark with scaffold splits
- A virtual screening campaign with docking and rescoring
- A sequence-to-function predictor with identity-aware evaluation
- A generative design loop with experimental constraints
- Peer review and reproducibility checklist
:::

## Planned learning outcomes

1. Scope, execute and document an end-to-end project with honest evaluation.
2. Communicate results to domain scientists with the right plots and uncertainty.
3. Package a project so that someone else can reproduce it.

## In the meantime

Part IV assumes Parts I–III. Start with [Chapter 0](../../part-1-foundations/ch00-start-here/index.html) if you are new.
